currentParagraphText: “Great,” Artemis said as she took out a token and tossed it to Jake. “Use this before going through one of the gateways, and you will reach an outpost close to the hunting ground. I figure you can handle the rest from there.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake caught the token and nodded as he also wanted to clarify one more thing. “No one will be watching me while I’m doing this, right? You won’t assign me people who are hiding and making sure I don’t mess up and find myself killed?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “And I’ll gladly be the hunter that gets the job done,” Jake responded, beginning to feel a little hyped up to finally get his body moving again after spending so long only training with mortal stats in the Emblem or meditating.
